First, note:  
12 PM = 12:00 (noon) in US/Pacific (UTC-8).  
Europe/London in March 2018 is UTC+0 (no DST yet on March 19? Actually, DST in UK starts last Sunday of March, which in 2018 was March 25, so March 19 is still GMT/UTC+0).  

Target time = 12:00 + (0 - (-8)) = 12:00 + 8 = 20:00 same day.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 20:00
